description: This file defines the ProfileBottomSheetDialog class, a UI component for displaying user profile actions in a bottom sheet dialog within the Notes Android application. It manages view binding, populates user info, and handles interactions like opening URLs, sending emails, and initiating communication via Talk.

classes.name: ProfileBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: A bottom sheet dialog fragment that displays user profile actions, including email, profile link, and other app-specific actions, within the Notes Android application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, inflates the layout, sets user info, and populates action buttons based on HoverCard actions.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Dispatches actions based on appId, such as opening websites, sending emails, or opening Talk.

methods.name: openWebsite
methods.description: Starts an intent to open a URL in the browser.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Creates and starts an intent to send an email to the specified address.

methods.name: openTalk
methods.description: Intended to initiate a Talk session but currently contains commented-out placeholder code.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up the view binding when the dialog stops.
